title: Privacy Policy
introduction: The website {{siteLink}} uses cookies and similar technologies to ensure proper functioning and improve user experience. On this page you will find detailed information on the use of cookies and personal data management.
cookieDefinition: Cookies are small text files that are saved by your browser on your device when you visit a website. They serve to store preferences, sessions and other information useful for navigation.
technicalCookieDesc: essential for the website to function, such as session management and navigation preferences.
preferenceCookieDesc: store user choices (e.g. language, theme) to improve experience.
cookieInfo: The website does not use profiling, marketing or tracking cookies and does not integrate third-party services that collect data for advertising or statistical purposes.
i18nextCookieDesc: stores the selected language, if present.
consentCookieDesc: stores the user's choice regarding cookie acceptance.
cookiesEssential: These cookies are essential for the website to function and do not collect personal data for profiling purposes.
consentInfo: On first access a banner is displayed to manage cookie consent. You can change your preferences at any time through your browser settings.
accessRight: Right of access, rectification and deletion of personal data.
exerciseRights: To exercise your rights you can contact the data controller at the contact details indicated below.
updatedAt: This privacy notice was last updated on July 27, 2025.
